limitations: Community records are not individually operator verified. Download and OSM edit dates do not prove a business is open. Missing or stale closure information may remain.

Missing branches, independent businesses, non-allowlisted chains and tags outside the query are omitted. Nearest means nearest included record. This is not all restaurants or all branches in Metro Vancouver.

Categories use allowlisted primary business formats after requiring a food-related OSM tag: coffee chains (including Tim Hortons) are Coffee shop, takeout/quick-service chains are Fast food and sit-down chains are Restaurant. Some individual branches offer different formats.

Official locator listings are checked at retrieval, not by phone or field visit; operating status, access restrictions and services can change. Hospital, mall, airport and in-store outlets may have restricted access.
Coordinates are approximate. Community ways use bounding-box centres; official pins and civic parcel points are not verified entrances. Addresses/cities missing from OSM are left blank.

OSM duplicates require compatible branch/unit/level/address tags and a short distance. Official replacement is one-to-one using a matching civic address or unique close point, preserving separate official outlet IDs. Some undetected duplicates may remain.
Tim Hortons data includes locations whose official coordinates are outside the requested rectangle; these are excluded and audited rather than relocated by guesswork.
No paid service is used. All data is a saved offline snapshot; visitors make no locator, geocoder or Overpass calls.
refresh_policy: One bounded Overpass POST; public A&W locator once; Tim Hortons index/branch HTML at max three simultaneous requests; Second Cup index/branch and one BC civic geocode. No automatic retries. Validate before atomic published-file replacement.
